_note: Close planetary pairings, groupings, and oppositions worth observing, late 2026 through 2027. Conjunction dates follow the JPL DE440-derived tables (in-the-sky.org); local-date discrepancies are noted where sources differ. Opposition/conjunction magnitudes added 2026-09-17 from in-the-sky.org (JPL DE440) and EarthSky; Uranus 2027 at ~5.7 per Sky & Telescope. Each event carries mag = limiting magnitude (dimmest body that matters; for pairings the fainter planet). Used by the go-score brightness factor: targets past the suburban naked-eye limit score lower.
